payload.summary: Diagnosis: listMarkdownDocs (src/store/layout.ts) filters readdir by name suffix only, so a directory named *.md flows into install's prune loop; removeFile->unlink raises EISDIR (macOS)/EPERM (Linux), which removeFile deliberately doesn't swallow -> install crashes. Rejected fixing removeFile (would silently mask junk + mask real bugs at other call sites). Fix: withFileTypes + exclude directories in listMarkdownDocs; symlinks still pass. Red-first repro in tests/commands/install.test.ts. Suite 864/0, tsc clean. PR #15.
